Cyclone Akvan Approaches India's East Coast, Expected to Make Landfall

Cyclone Akvan is intensifying in the Bay of Bengal and is projected to make landfall on India's east coast, specifically between Nellore and Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, on November 20. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha. The cyclone is expected to become a severe storm, with wind speeds potentially reaching up to 130 kilometers per hour during landfall. In response to the approaching storm, Odisha has restricted beach tourism and coastal recreation. One report also noted that outer cloud bands of Cyclone Akvan were reaching south Bengal, potentially bringing light rain to Calcutta.
